title: Energy-Structured Latent World Models with Neural Time Fields for Physically Constistent Open-World Motion Planning
summary: Energy-Structured Latent World Models with Neural Time Fields for Physically Constistent Open-World Motion Planning｜Physically consistent motion planning remains a fundamental chal

extra.description: Physically consistent motion planning remains a fundamental challenge in embodied AI, as generated trajectories must strictly conform to real-world execution dynamics. While latent world models offer a promising approach by predicting these dynamics, existing methods learn unconstrained future representations where absorbed physics remains implicit.
